terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of <1>Songuess</1>, a real-time multiplayer music trivia game. By accessing or using Songuess, you agree to these Terms.

sections.academicBody: Songuess is an academic project developed by students at <1>42</1> as part of the ft_transcendence curriculum. It is a learning exercise and MVP, not a commercial product or a publicly operated online service.
sections.intendedBody1: Songuess is intended solely for local development, testing, and evaluation — including project reviews and peer assessments at 42. It is not designed for general public use on the Internet, and we do not offer it as a hosted service to external users.
sections.intendedBody2: You may access Songuess only in environments where the project is deployed for academic purposes (for example, a local or school-provided setup used during evaluation).
sections.acceptableIntro: You agree to use Songuess responsibly and in good faith. You must not:
sections.acceptableRule1: Attempt to disrupt, exploit, or reverse-engineer the application or its infrastructure.
sections.acceptableRule2: Use the service to harass, impersonate, or harm other players.
sections.acceptableRule3: Share credentials or attempt to access accounts that are not yours.
sections.acceptableRule4: Use automated tools or scripts to interfere with gameplay or server operations.
sections.acceptableOutro: We may restrict or terminate access if we determine that use is abusive or incompatible with the academic purpose of the project.
sections.availabilityBody: Songuess is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. Because it is an MVP under active development, we do <1>not</1> guarantee continuous availability, uptime, data persistence, or error-free operation. The service may be offline, reset, or unavailable at any time without notice — including during evaluations, demos, or development work.
sections.changesDevBody: The development team may add, modify, or remove features, rules, or data at any time as part of ongoing work on the project. Game mechanics, authentication flows, and stored data models may change without prior notice. You acknowledge that your experience may differ between versions and evaluation sessions.
sections.spotifyBody1: Songuess uses <1>Spotify</1> solely for user authentication and, with your consent, to retrieve profile and listening-taste information used inside the app. Your use of Spotify login is also subject to Spotify's own terms and privacy policies.
sections.spotifyBody2: We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or responsible for Spotify. If Spotify is unavailable or changes its API, Spotify login or related features in Songuess may stop working without notice.
sections.accountsBody1: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide when registering (email, username, and password) or when signing in with Spotify. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials.
sections.accountsBody2: Songuess does not claim ownership over music previews or metadata surfaced through Spotify during gameplay. All music-related content remains subject to Spotify's terms and applicable copyright law.
sections.liabilityBody: To the fullest extent permitted in this academic context, the developers of Songuess are not liable for any loss of data, interrupted gameplay, or other damages arising from use of this MVP. The project is provided free of charge, without monetization, advertising, or warranties of any kind.
sections.contactBody: For questions about these Terms or about your data, contact the development team through the GitHub profiles listed on the <1>home page</1>.
sections.changesTermsBody: We may update these Terms as the project evolves. Continued use of Songuess after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page indicates the latest revision.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how <1>Songuess</1> — a real-time multiplayer music trivia game developed as an academic project at 42 — collects, uses, and stores personal information. Songuess is currently an MVP intended for local development, testing, and evaluation only. It is not designed for public deployment on the Internet.

sections.dataIntro: When you create an account or sign in, we store only the information needed to run the application:
sections.dataRule1: <1>Account data:</1> email address, username, and a bcrypt-hashed password (we never store your password in plain text).
sections.dataRule2: <1>Session data:</1> hashed refresh tokens linked to your account, plus short-lived access tokens delivered through HTTP-only cookies (<3>access_token</3>, <5>refresh_token</5>).
sections.dataRule3: <1>Spotify profile data</1> (optional, only if you sign in with Spotify): Spotify user ID, display name, email, profile image URL, your top artists and genres, and your most-listened tracks (recent and all-time). This data is refreshed each time you authenticate with Spotify.
sections.dataOutro1: During active multiplayer matches, your display name and score are held in server memory so other players can see them. Match results are not permanently stored in our database.
sections.dataOutro2: Your browser may also store a login flag, session timing values, and game cooldown timestamps in <1>localStorage</1>. These are used for session management and gameplay mechanics only.
sections.spotifyBody1: If you choose “Continue with Spotify,” we redirect you to Spotify's authorization page. With your consent, Spotify shares profile and listening-taste data through the following scopes: <1>user-read-email</1>, <3>user-read-private</3>, and <5>user-top-read</5>.
sections.spotifyBody2: From Spotify we receive your profile information (ID, email, display name, avatar) and your top artists, derived genres, and top tracks. Spotify OAuth access tokens are used only during the login callback and are <1>not</1> stored long-term on our servers.
sections.spotifyBody3: Spotify is the only third-party service used for user authentication. We do not integrate with any other external login providers.
sections.useIntro: We use the data described above exclusively to:
sections.useRule1: Create and manage your Songuess account and session.
sections.useRule2: Display your profile and optional Spotify taste data inside the app.
sections.useRule3: Identify you during multiplayer rooms and matches (display name and score).
sections.useRule4: Keep the application secure and functioning correctly.
sections.useOutro: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing or advertising. Songuess has no monetization, no advertising, and no analytics or tracking services.
sections.academicBody: Songuess is a student project built for the ft_transcendence curriculum at 42. It runs in a local development and evaluation environment. We do not operate it as a commercial or publicly hosted service, and we do not guarantee the same protections or availability you would expect from a production application.
sections.retentionBody1: Account and Spotify profile data remain stored while your account exists. Session tokens expire automatically (access tokens after 15 minutes; refresh tokens after 30 days, or sooner if you log out).
sections.retentionBody2: Songuess does not currently offer an in-app account deletion feature. If you want your stored data removed, please contact the development team through their GitHub profiles listed on the <1>home page</1>. We will handle deletion requests on a best-effort basis within this academic project context.
sections.changesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy as the project evolves during development and evaluation. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page will reflect the most recent revision.

setup.title: Setup guide
setup.intro: We checked this environment and highlighted anything that still needs your attention.
setup.introNewMachine: This looks like a different host than before. Local URLs and certificates were adjusted automatically where possible.
setup.playWithoutSpotify: You can play right now with the built-in Classic Mix playlist — no Spotify account required.

spotify_content_credentials.title: Configure Spotify search credentials
spotify_content_credentials.body: Edit srcs/backend/content-service/.env and set CLIENT_ID and CLIENT_SECRET from your Spotify Developer app. This enables track search during matches and catalog search in the lobby.

spotify_oauth_credentials.title: Configure Spotify login (optional)
spotify_oauth_credentials.body: Edit srcs/backend/auth-service/.env with SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID, SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET, and TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Required only to link your Spotify account and share personal playlists.

spotify_redirect_uri.title: Register the Spotify redirect URI
spotify_redirect_uri.body: In the Spotify Developer Dashboard, add this exact redirect URI: {{redirectUri}}. It must match SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI in auth-service/.env.

media_library.title: Add local preview files
media_library.body: The built-in playlist needs MP3 previews in srcs/frontend/public/media/. Run: bash infra/scripts/downloader_home.sh <playlist.csv> then make playlist (or make up).

trust_certificate.title: Trust the local HTTPS certificate
trust_certificate.body: Open {{accessUrl}} and accept the self-signed certificate warning in your browser so API calls and WebSockets work.

run_make_up.title: Start the Docker stack
run_make_up.body: From the project root run make up. Ensure Docker is running and ports 8443/5173 are free.
